Class PetstoreConsolePage

All Implemented Interfaces:

Direct Known Subclasses:
AboutRest, AuditRest, ChangesRest, ChartsRest, CustomCardsRest, DashboardRest, DataRest, DevRest, FlavorsRest, FreemarkerFlavorRest, HtmlFlavorRest, JobsRest, MustacheFlavorRest, OpsRest, OrdersRest, PetsRest, PetstoreConsoleResource, SecureApiRest, SecureRest, StoreRest, ThemesRest, UsersRest
public abstract class PetstoreConsolePage extends BasicRestServlet
Base class for every petstore console page resource: registers the console FreeMarker mixin with base.ftlh as chrome, and injects the shared PetStore.

Children don't inherit the parent's mixins, so every page class extends this one instead of re-declaring the mixin, which E-B12 would reject.

The views and DataTables toolkit packs link their assets page-relative (e.g. /console/store/juneau-views.js), so every page also composes ViewsMixin and DataTablesMixin to serve them from its own mount.

Example:

@Rest(path="/ops/audit") public class AuditRest extends PetstoreConsolePage { @RestGet(path="/") public View page() { return FreemarkerView.of("audit.ftlh"); } }
